newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Yemeni for burning national to death.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Yemeni for burning national to death.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Saturday beheaded a Yemeni man for burning a Saudi national to death, The official Saudi Press Agency said.
It quoted an Interior Ministry statement as saying the execution took place in the southern Aseer province.

The execution brought to 45 the number of beheadings in the conservative kingdom this year. Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers and rapists.
